thread:
oliver: quick flag: support asked why their canary showed multiple "fallback" rows with no way to link to the policy or trigger. we need clearer attribution in console AND in ops flows.

priya: +1. In the heat of an incident we need a single stable key to jump from console -> eventstore -> logs. Also prefer machine-friendly codes for triggers, not free text.

ben: proposal: add compact decision token `fb=<short>` everywhere: console row, telemetry tag, and optionally in a response header for internal debug sessions. token format: fb:base36(8).

marcos: UX: keep console dense. Show small token + trigger pill (eg TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMIT, MODEL_OOM). Expand opens side panel with clickable "open event" (prefilters eventstore by token) and a tiny timeline for chained fallbacks.

oliver: also capture policy_name + policy_version + decision_id + parent_decision_id (if chained). The event payload should include model_digest for exact artifact.

priya: debate: headers vs telemetry-only. headers = quick dev feedback, but must be opt-in per org/api-key. product and security worry about surface area. we should never include prompt or user content in header.

ben: implementation note: decision_id must be deterministic across retries within a time window. suggest hash(trace_id || policy_v || floor(ts/60)). encode base62 and truncate to 10 chars.

marcos: sampling: high-volume routes cannot show every fallback in UI. add sampling_rate_in_ui and tail-sampling behavior. console shows sampled examples, eventstore retains full stream.

oliver: audit requirements: add CSV export of timeline, link to operator override history (who/when/reason/ttl), and retention per-org settings (hosted default 90d, overridable).

priya: telemetry schema: small proto with fields: decision_id, policy, policy_version, trigger_code (enum), from_variant, to_variant, parent_decision_id (opt), sampled(bool), elapsed_ms. emit counter.fallbacks_by_trigger and histogram.fallback_latency_ms.

audit-bot: :information_source: feature-flag plan: "rw.fallback.token_header" -> internal orgs first. eventstore always receives full payload.

ben: frontend: column "FB" with copy button and pill. expand -> panel with event link, model digests, config diff snapshot, and export. default collapsed.

marcos: tests: unit for id-gen, e2e asserting header only when flag ON and api-key allowed, UI test for panel + csv, perf test for header overhead at 2k rps.

oliver: small ops-ux ask: add `rw-fb inspect <fb>` cli that prints summary and opens event url. helps oncall.

priya: one more: for chained fallbacks show parent -> child graph and surface the chain in alerts (eg fb:a1b2 -> fb:c3d4). that makes postmortems easier.

ben: security note: redact any user content from telemetry visible in console. store raw_reason in eventstore with RBAC.

marcos: i'll mock the side panel and timeline in figma. oliver will draft RFC with header example, proto schema, and opt-in flag behavior. tagging @eng-sre and @eng-ml for model-switch hooks.

oliver: thanks — will post RFC tomorrow and include minimal e2e harness.
